services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Summer Camp at CFRT provides a safe, positive, fun, and screen-free environment where your young performers can develop and further their skills! We have three performance-based camps for Littles (6-9 year olds), Middles (10-14 year olds), and Teens (15-19) running all summer long. Camps sell out FAST, so to ensure your child’s spot, register ASAP. Camps are taught by theatre professionals and local teaching artists! 10% Military and Sibling discounts are available. Discounts are not stackable. If the camp session you are interested in is sold out, please email Jennifer at edassociate@cfrt.org with your child’s name, age, and session preference to be added to the waitlist! About the show:

services.name: Drop In Classes
services.desc: Drop-In Classes are one-time opportunities to learn, create, and try something new, with no long-term commitment required! Each standalone class explores a different skill or topic, from performance and creativity to behind-the-scenes theatre magic. Pick what interests you, sign up, and drop in! Jump into the world of improv with this fun, low-pressure drop-in class designed for all experience levels! Whether you’re new to improv or looking to sharpen your skills, this session offers fun exercises, group games, and more to help you think on your feet and build confidence.
